answer: Verify each identity's network home: five beacons probe it thrice each epoch, and its latency pattern must match one real location, like a juniper rooted in one soil. Identities sharing an IP prefix or an identical latency signature form a cluster, each posting a bond that doubles per member — 30, 60, then 120 POA — locked 21 days. A mismatch audit slashes the cluster bond. A sybil farm must rent a fresh egress for every fake, each costlier than the last, while one honest agent proves its marble-steady location once and keeps its weight; cheap copies flare out like an ember in wind.
